page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-48-lssd is a virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 48 dedicated vCPUs and 186.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of memory per core. The instance operates with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This configuration does not include any GPU hardware, and the local storage size is specified as None, utilizing NVMe SSD storage types. Benchmark data for this specific instance type, including single-core and multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations, is currently unavailable.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance for workloads requiring consistent compute resources without the overhead of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. Appropriate workloads for this resource profile include general-purpose web serving, medium-scale databases, containerized applications, and standard enterprise application hosting.
